rows.0__no_training_likely: 0 accelerators, or normalized accelerator pool below the policy minimum after excluding failed/partitioned devices.
rows.1__training_possible: Pool is at or above the policy feasibility threshold. Illustrative tiers: 8-64 small, 64-512 medium, 512-2,000 large-capable, >2,000 very-large/frontier-capable.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: N/A by design: capacity alone must not raise training probability above possible.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: N/A by design: no activity inference from count alone.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: N/A by design: high count is capacity/context only, not proof of a run.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Use current signed inventory; compute count by SKU and normalized H100e-equivalent capacity; do not aggregate as an activity time series.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Cap at 'training possible'. Requires topology, homogeneity, power/cooling, and non-partitioned availability. Use normalized H100e/sustained-training units rather than raw chip count.
rows.observable: Hardware inventory and accelerator capacity
rows.original_caveats: Use log-scaled count; normalize by hardware generation. Count alone is capacity, not activity.
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: 0: none; 1-8: single-node/small; 8-64: pod/small training or inference; 64-512: medium cluster; 512-2,000: large; >2,000: very large/frontier-capable depending generation
rows.suggested_aggregation_window: daily/hourly inventory snapshot; evaluate over audit window

rows.0__no_training_likely: Below the regulated-event compute/capacity threshold; large run impossible on monitored capacity.
rows.1__training_possible: At or above threshold; only establishes feasibility.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: N/A by design.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: N/A by design.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: N/A by design.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Convert SKU count to sustained training capacity using a versioned hardware-normalization table.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Cap at 'training possible'. Assumes sustained training efficiency, chip generation, precision, and power caps are known.
rows.observable: Hardware inventory and accelerator capacity
rows.original_caveats: Use for capacity gate. Prefer sustained BF16/FP8 training estimate over marketing peak.
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Convert each SKU to a common sustained-training-capacity unit; <threshold means impossible; above threshold only means feasible
rows.suggested_aggregation_window: daily/hourly inventory; update on hardware/config changes

rows.0__no_training_likely: <0.3 high-end homogeneous fraction, or no large same-SKU pool; large synchronous training is unlikely/possibly infeasible.
rows.1__training_possible: 0.3-0.8 supports some training if enough total capacity; >0.8 strongly supports feasibility for large synchronized training.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: N/A by design.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: N/A by design.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: N/A by design.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Compute over the candidate low-latency domain, not just whole site.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Cap at 'training possible'. Fraction matters only with count, topology, and availability; inference fleets can also be homogeneous.
rows.observable: Hardware inventory and accelerator capacity
rows.original_caveats: Training usually prefers homogeneous fleets; inference can tolerate heterogeneity.
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: >0.8 supports large synchronized run feasibility; <0.3 implies fragmented/mixed use
rows.possible_value_range: 0 all heterogeneous; 1 all same high-end SKU

rows.0__no_training_likely: No low-latency fabric, single-GPU islands, or domains too small for the policy-scale run.
rows.1__training_possible: 8-GPU domains support node-scale training; 64/72+ GPU domains or low-oversubscription pods support larger feasible runs.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: N/A by design.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: N/A by design.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: N/A by design.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Extract largest contiguous accelerator subgraph and oversubscription/diameter metrics.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Cap at 'training possible'. Graph diameter, oversubscription, rail layout, and NIC locality matter more than raw domain size.
rows.observable: Hardware inventory and accelerator capacity
rows.original_caveats: Graph diameter and oversubscription matter more than raw count.
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Single GPU/no fabric: weak; 8-GPU islands: node-scale; 72-GPU NVLink domain or tightly connected pods: strong capacity
rows.suggested_aggregation_window: inventory plus topology snapshot; refresh on cabling/switch changes

rows.0__no_training_likely: >0.8 partitioned into small slices during the window; monolithic threshold-scale training unlikely unless reconfigured.
rows.1__training_possible: <0.2 partitioned and full GPUs available means training is feasible; 0.2-0.8 mixed means only partial feasibility.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: N/A as activity; sudden repartitioning may be an integrity/configuration anomaly but not training evidence.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: N/A by design.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: N/A by design.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Compute partitioned fraction by GPU-hours, not just inventory count.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Cap at 'training possible'. Treat MIG/vGPU state changes as separate config events; do not infer a run without activity signals.
rows.observable: Hardware inventory and accelerator capacity
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: High partitioning supports inference/multi-tenancy; low partitioning supports large monolithic training

rows.0__no_training_likely: Stable signed inventory; zero or authorized changes outside candidate windows.
rows.1__training_possible: Authorized additions/removals explain capacity changes; not activity evidence.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: Unexpected additions/removals or large discrepancies during the audit window are an integrity anomaly, not direct training evidence.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: N/A as training evidence by design.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Capacity/tamper warning only if off-ledger additions align with power, scheduler gaps, or telemetry gaps.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Track signed deltas and reconcile with RMA, physical maintenance, attestation, and BMC records.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: User-specified base-capacity rule applies: do not use inventory deltas as positive run evidence beyond feasibility; route anomalies to integrity review.
rows.observable: Hardware inventory and accelerator capacity
rows.original_caveats: Cross-check with physical and RMA records.
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Unexpected additions/removals during audit window reduce confidence and may signal concealed capacity

rows.0__no_training_likely: 0 allocated GPUs, or only tiny allocations with no linked job group.
rows.1__training_possible: 1-8 GPUs: single-node/small; 8-64: small distributed, inference, benchmark, or fine-tune possible.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 64-512 GPUs for one job/linked group, especially homogeneous and concurrent, is a serious candidate but ambiguous with HPC/inference.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: 512-2,000 GPUs, or >50% of a relevant topology domain, allocated contiguously to one linked workload for sustained time.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: >2,000 GPUs or above the policy concurrency threshold under one linked account/job group; highest warning only if duration plus GPU/fabric/power activity agree.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: For each window compute max concurrent allocated normalized GPUs, linked-job group count, and fraction of topology domain/site.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Depends strongly on duration, topology contiguity, GPU generation, utilization, and account/job-linking logic.
rows.observable: Scheduler, job, reservation, and allocation metadata
rows.original_caveats: One of the highest-value features when scheduler coverage is complete.
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: 1-8: single-node; 8-64: small distributed; 64-512: serious training/HPC; 512-2,000: large; >2,000: very large
rows.signal_data_field: Allocated GPU count per job or linked job group
rows.suggested_aggregation_window: job event; aggregate over 15m, 1h, day, week

rows.0__no_training_likely: No allocation or <1 hour at small scale; usually idle, launch failure, benchmark, or transient inference.
rows.1__training_possible: 1-24 hours: small training, fine-tune, benchmark, or batch job possible.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 1-7 days at material concurrency: substantial candidate window.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: >7 days at large concurrency: strong large-training candidate.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: >30 days or sustained duration crossing policy GPU-hour threshold with activity corroboration.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Compute wall-clock duration and continuous busy duration separately; handle pauses/preemptions.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Interpret only with allocated GPU count and utilization; a long 8-GPU job is not a large training run.
rows.observable: Scheduler, job, reservation, and allocation metadata
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: <1h benchmark/inference burst; 1-24h small run; 1-7d substantial; >7d strong large-training candidate; >30d frontier-scale candidate

rows.0__no_training_likely: 0, or <5% of the policy GPU-hour/compute-hour threshold.
rows.1__training_possible: 5-25% of threshold: training possible but below regulated-event mass.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 25-100% of threshold, or multiple linked sub-threshold jobs: elevated candidate.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: 1-3x threshold with continuous high concurrency and activity.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: >3x threshold, or any value above the legal threshold plus corroborating scheduler/GPU/fabric/power evidence.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Compute count × duration × hardware-normalization factor; store both raw and normalized GPU-hours.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Use normalized H100e-hours or sustained-FLOP-hours; fragmentation across jobs/accounts must be linked.
rows.observable: Scheduler, job, reservation, and allocation metadata
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Large if count×duration crosses chosen policy threshold; very large if continuous high-concurrency multi-day

rows.0__no_training_likely: 0 or <0.05 of the relevant site/fabric/topology domain.
rows.1__training_possible: 0.05-0.20: enough for small training or batch work.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 0.20-0.50: material site-level concentration; elevated if one linked workload.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: 0.50-0.80: strong site/domain-level run candidate.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: >0.80 of a relevant domain/site is extreme; highest warning if homogeneous, contiguous, and sustained with activity.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Use max and duty cycle above 0.2/0.5/0.8 thresholds.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Compute fraction over the relevant low-latency domain, not whole company fleet; depends on topology and site segmentation.
rows.observable: Scheduler, job, reservation, and allocation metadata
rows.original_caveats: Use per topology domain, not only whole site.
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: >0.2 material; >0.5 strong site-level run; >0.8 extreme unless cloud region is dedicated

rows.0__no_training_likely: <0.2 contiguity or scattered allocations across distant racks/regions; weak for one synchronous run.
rows.1__training_possible: 0.2-0.5: possible, but likely fragmented or multi-purpose unless other signals show synchronization.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 0.5-0.75: elevated if combined with high GPU count.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: 0.75-0.90: likely single coordinated large workload when count and duration are high.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: >0.90 contiguous low-latency allocation at policy scale plus fabric/rank evidence.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Compute graph contiguity, rack/pod concentration, placement group membership, and oversubscription.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Requires accurate topology graph; high contiguity can also describe HPC or reserved inference clusters.
rows.observable: Scheduler, job, reservation, and allocation metadata
rows.original_caveats: Should be derived from node/rack/fabric graph.
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: High contiguity supports training; scattered allocations weaken synchronized run feasibility

rows.0__no_training_likely: Signed declaration says inference/HPC/eval/data and all telemetry is consistent with that claim.
rows.1__training_possible: Unknown, generic, missing, or small-scale 'experiment' label.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: Training/fine-tuning-like label, or unknown label at large scale.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: Signed train/fine-tune/pretrain declaration at large allocation scale.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Signed declaration plus authentic ML logs/checkpoints/activity crossing policy threshold.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Encode declared class, signature status, and consistency with other layers.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Treat declarations as evidence, not proof; adversary can mislabel. Strong only if signed and cross-checked.
rows.observable: Scheduler, job, reservation, and allocation metadata
rows.original_caveats: Treat declarations as evidence, not proof.
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Self-declared train is useful but insufficient; unknown at large scale should trigger cross-checks
rows.suggested_aggregation_window: job event; pre-run and post-run declaration

rows.0__no_training_likely: Short, opportunistic, preemptible, high-churn jobs at small scale.
rows.1__training_possible: On-demand or reserved short jobs; possible but not distinctive.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: Multi-day reserved, non-preemptible, or high-priority block for high-end GPUs.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: Long exclusive reservation with high concurrency and low preemption.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Exclusive non-preemptible policy-scale reservation plus synchronized activity and billing continuity.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Track reservation size, duration, preemption count, priority, and exclusive-use flags.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Reservation alone is a commitment/capacity signal; confirm actual use with scheduler, billing, GPU, fabric, and power.
rows.observable: Scheduler, job, reservation, and allocation metadata
rows.original_caveats: Some training uses spot with checkpointing.
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Long reserved non-preemptible blocks support training; high preemption suggests opportunistic or fragmented jobs

rows.0__no_training_likely: 0, tiny, or heterogeneous provisioning events; no high-end training SKUs.
rows.1__training_possible: 1-8 high-end training instances or <64 GPUs created in a tight window.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 64-512 high-end GPUs provisioned/reserved together, especially same instance type.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: 512-2,000 high-end GPUs launched/reserved synchronously with EFA/RDMA/cluster placement.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: >2,000 GPUs or above policy concurrency under one account/org with cluster placement and continuous billing; highest warning requires activity corroboration.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Group RunInstances/CreateCapacityReservation events by account/org, region/AZ, instance type, placement group, and time burst.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Cloud API events show provisioning, not workload semantics; aggregate by beneficial owner across accounts/regions/providers.
rows.observable: Cloud control-plane, capacity reservation, and billing records
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Hundreds of high-end GPUs created in a tight window is strong candidate; small frequent events more inference-like
rows.suggested_aggregation_window: minutes for launch; hourly/day for usage

rows.0__no_training_likely: No high-end reservation, or very short reservation with no usage.
rows.1__training_possible: Hours to 1 day: possible benchmark, fine-tune, or surge capacity.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 2-7 days of high-end reserved capacity: elevated precursor.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: 7-30 days at large size: likely large training or HPC campaign.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: >30 days or very large aggregate reservations; highest warning only if continuous usage and activity evidence agree.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Use reserved GPU-days and actual used GPU-hours separately.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Reservation can be inference/HPC/benchmarking; combine with instance type, EFA, placement group, billing, and utilization.
rows.observable: Cloud control-plane, capacity reservation, and billing records
rows.original_caveats: Reservation alone is capacity/activity commitment, not proof of training.
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Multi-day to multi-week high-end reservations are strong large-run precursor; hours may be benchmark

rows.0__no_training_likely: 0 or fleet dominated by inference/CPU/storage SKUs.
rows.1__training_possible: 0.3-0.6 training-SKU fraction: possible mixed workload.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 0.6-0.8 high-end training SKUs with low-latency networking.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: >0.8 homogeneous high-end training SKUs plus EFA/RDMA/cluster placement at scale.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: >0.95 homogeneous training SKUs at policy scale with long duration and billing continuity.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Compute fraction of GPU-hours on training-class SKUs and same-SKU homogeneity.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Product taxonomy must be updated as hardware changes; training SKUs can also serve inference or HPC.
rows.observable: Cloud control-plane, capacity reservation, and billing records
rows.original_caveats: Classification must update as products change.
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: High fraction plus EFA/RDMA/cluster placement strong; mixed CPU/GPU weakens

rows.0__no_training_likely: No high GPU spend, or clear autoscaling/diurnal variation; diurnal index high relative to account baseline.
rows.1__training_possible: Moderate spend with variable pattern; possible mixed workload.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: High GPU spend with low diurnal variation for >=24h; elevated training/HPC candidate.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: Flat high-end GPU billing for >3 days with low churn and consistent instance count.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Flat high-end GPU billing for >7 days or crossing policy GPU-hour threshold, plus capacity reservation and activity corroboration.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Use CV/diurnal ratio, continuous line-item usage, and absence of scale-down gaps.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Low diurnal variation distinguishes training/HPC from demand-driven serving, but not training from HPC.
rows.observable: Cloud control-plane, capacity reservation, and billing records
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Continuous high spend with low diurnal variation supports training or HPC; diurnal spikes support serving

rows.0__no_training_likely: No unusual egress or only baseline serving/logging traffic.
rows.1__training_possible: GB-low-TB movement; ordinary data movement possible.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: Large TB-scale movement before/after a candidate job, especially to/from training accounts.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: Very large TB-PB movement aligned with checkpoint/model export after a large activity window.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: PB-scale checkpoint/model-sized export linked to same account/job immediately after threshold-scale activity; supportive high warning only.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Compute pre-run ingress, post-run egress, destination/account linkage, and cross-provider transfers.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Storage/model movement is supportive, not standalone; could be ETL, backup, or dataset migration.
rows.observable: Cloud control-plane, capacity reservation, and billing records
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Large post-run egress/export may indicate checkpoint/model transfer; not specific alone

rows.0__no_training_likely: <10% median across allocated GPUs, or no large allocation.
rows.1__training_possible: 10-40%: light/mixed use; training possible but weak.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 40-70% sustained across many GPUs: elevated heavy compute.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: >70% sustained across a large footprint for hours/days.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: >90% sustained across policy-scale footprint with scheduler, power, and fabric corroboration.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Use p50/p95 utilization, duty cycle above 70/90, number of GPUs, and duration; do not use max alone.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Not unique to training; batch inference, synthetic data, benchmarks, and HPC can be highly utilized.
rows.observable: On-device GPU telemetry: utilization, memory, power, health, process accounting
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: <10 idle; 10-40 light/mixed; 40-70 moderate/bursty; >70 sustained across many GPUs supports heavy compute; >90 sustained strong
rows.source_basis: Uploaded matrix/notes; NVIDIA DCGM/NVML and cloud GPU monitoring docs

rows.0__no_training_likely: <10% or absent tensor/SM activity during alleged large run.
rows.1__training_possible: 10-40%: possible light ML or mixed workload.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 40-70% sustained dense tensor activity across many GPUs.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: >70% sustained tensor/SM activity over large footprint.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: >85-90% sustained tensor activity at policy scale plus fabric/rank/storage evidence.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Compute sustained active fraction and correlation with power/fabric bursts.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Availability depends on counters and security mode; high tensor activity is dense ML/HPC but not necessarily training.
rows.observable: On-device GPU telemetry: utilization, memory, power, health, process accounting
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: High sustained tensor activity across job footprint supports dense ML computation; low SM with high memory may be inference/storage/data movement
rows.source_basis: Uploaded matrix/notes; NVIDIA DCGM/NVML and cloud GPU monitoring docs

rows.0__no_training_likely: <0.2 across allocated GPUs; inconsistent with large model training.
rows.1__training_possible: 0.2-0.6: model serving, small jobs, or partial occupancy possible.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 0.6-0.8 stable across many GPUs: elevated large-model workload.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: 0.8-0.95 stable across many ranks/GPUs with high compute.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: 0.8-0.95 plus optimizer-state/checkpoint/rank evidence at policy scale; ~1.0 alone may indicate OOM/cache, not proof.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Use median and low variance across same role/rank; track free-memory residual.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Inference with large models/KV cache can also use high HBM; combine with optimizer/checkpoints/fabric.
rows.observable: On-device GPU telemetry: utilization, memory, power, health, process accounting
rows.original_caveats: Inference can also use high HBM for large models/KV cache.
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: <0.2 light; 0.2-0.6 model serving or small jobs; 0.6-0.95 large model/training; ~1 may OOM/cache
rows.source_basis: Uploaded matrix/notes; NVIDIA DCGM/NVML and cloud GPU monitoring docs

rows.0__no_training_likely: <10% or low bandwidth during alleged heavy compute.
rows.1__training_possible: 10-40%: possible mixed or serving.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 40-70% sustained bandwidth with compute activity.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: >70% sustained bandwidth plus high SM/tensor activity.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: >80-90% sustained bandwidth at policy scale with training-like step/fabric patterns.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Use joint bins with SM/tensor active and HBM used fraction.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: High memory bandwidth with low compute may be inference decode, data movement, or memory-bound HPC.
rows.observable: On-device GPU telemetry: utilization, memory, power, health, process accounting
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Sustained high bandwidth plus high compute supports training; high bandwidth with low compute may be decode/inference or data movement
rows.source_basis: Uploaded matrix/notes; NVIDIA DCGM/NVML and cloud GPU monitoring docs

rows.0__no_training_likely: <0.2 of power cap/TDP; idle or low activity.
rows.1__training_possible: 0.2-0.6: mixed or moderate load.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 0.6-0.85 sustained across many GPUs: elevated heavy compute.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: >0.85 sustained across large footprint for hours/days.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: >0.85 across policy-scale footprint for long duration plus scheduler/fabric/storage evidence.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Normalize by current power cap; track energy, p95 power, and duty cycle.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Good anti-idle evidence but not semantic; underclocking/power caps can lower observed fraction.
rows.observable: On-device GPU telemetry: utilization, memory, power, health, process accounting
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: <0.2 idle; 0.2-0.6 mixed; 0.6-0.85 heavy; >0.85 sustained strong heavy compute
rows.source_basis: Uploaded matrix/notes; NVIDIA DCGM/NVML and cloud GPU monitoring docs

rows.0__no_training_likely: No long-lived GPU processes, or only one/few serving-like processes at small scale.
rows.1__training_possible: Few long-lived processes; training possible but weak.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: One similar process per GPU or rank-like pattern across 64-512 GPUs.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: Stable similar rank processes across >512 GPUs for hours/days.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Ranked training process tree with optimizer/checkpoint links at policy scale.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Count long-lived processes per GPU, memory per process, image hash recurrence, and PID-to-job linkage.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Process names should be hashed; strong only when process-to-job mapping and runtime metadata are authentic.
rows.observable: On-device GPU telemetry: utilization, memory, power, health, process accounting
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Many long-lived rank processes with similar memory supports distributed training; one/few serving processes supports inference
rows.source_basis: Uploaded matrix/notes; NVIDIA DCGM/NVML and cloud GPU monitoring docs

rows.0__no_training_likely: No unusual errors beyond baseline.
rows.1__training_possible: Low baseline errors; not training evidence.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: Error spikes during high-load windows indicate stress/health issues and can slightly support heavy activity.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: N/A as direct training evidence; may explain throttling or missing GPUs.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Integrity/availability warning if errors coincide with telemetry gaps or suspicious hardware swaps.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Compute error rates per GPU and align with power, utilization, replacements, and gaps.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Use for health, reliability, and integrity. Do not classify training from errors alone.
rows.observable: On-device GPU telemetry: utilization, memory, power, health, process accounting
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Spikes may indicate stress/failures; not training evidence, but affect reliability/availability
rows.source_basis: Uploaded matrix/notes; NVIDIA DCGM/NVML and cloud GPU monitoring docs

rows.0__no_training_likely: No GPU kernels, serving/eval-only pattern, or kernels inconsistent with training under candidate allocation.
rows.1__training_possible: GEMM/copy/attention kernels only; possible ML workload or benchmark.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: Repeated forward/backward-like sequence; elevated training candidate.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: Forward/backward/optimizer-like cycle across many ranks with stable cadence.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Authenticated profiler shows backward pass + optimizer/update kernels + checkpoint-associated steps at policy scale.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Use hashed kernel families/classes and sequence motifs, not raw names where privacy matters.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Very sensitive and often unavailable; kernel obfuscation/fusion can hide structure. HPC/benchmarks can mimic subsets.
rows.observable: GPU profiling and kernel/counter-level telemetry
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Repeated forward/backward/optimizer-like sequence supports training; GEMM-only loops may be benchmark
rows.suggested_aggregation_window: sampled profiling; 1-15m segments around candidate windows

rows.0__no_training_likely: <0.1 of expected sustained throughput, or no sustained tensor activity.
rows.1__training_possible: 0.1-0.3: possible inefficient or small workload.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 0.3-0.6 sustained across many GPUs.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: >0.6-0.8 sustained across a large footprint.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: >0.8 sustained for long windows with high utilization, fabric cadence, and scheduler alignment.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Normalize by power cap, precision mode, and expected sustained rather than marketing peak.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Calibrate by model/hardware; very efficient inference, GEMM benchmarks, and HPC can score high.
rows.observable: GPU profiling and kernel/counter-level telemetry
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: High sustained ratio over long windows supports dense training; very low ratio under high allocation may indicate memory-bound inference or inefficiency

rows.0__no_training_likely: Profiler/counter path available and shows no training-like patterns.
rows.1__training_possible: Available/unknown with no candidate activity; no positive evidence.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: Disabled, security-blocked, or unknown during a candidate high-allocation/high-power window.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: N/A as training evidence; this is an observability/integrity feature.

rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Loss curve plus optimizer state/checkpoints is highly semantic; serving/eval lacks optimizer updates

rows.0__no_training_likely: Valid attestation plus complete idle/activity evidence can support a no-run conclusion.
rows.1__training_possible: Valid or unknown attestation with no activity semantics.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: Expired/unknown/partial attestation reduces confidence in other telemetry.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: N/A as direct training evidence.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Integrity high warning if invalid attestation coincides with candidate activity, missing counters, or capacity discrepancies.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Encode validity, coverage fraction, measurement class, and revocation status.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Trust anchor only. It authenticates telemetry/hardware state but does not identify workload.
rows.observable: Attestation, trusted computing, and device/telemetry provenance
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Valid attestation increases trust; invalid/expired reduces evidentiary value; unknown requires conservative treatment

rows.0__no_training_likely: CC-Off/devtools/normal mode with counters available and other telemetry idle can support negative claims.
rows.1__training_possible: Known mode with no direct semantics; CC-On makes GPU-counter absence non-informative.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: CC-On or unknown mode during candidate activity elevates uncertainty because counters may be disabled.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: N/A as direct training evidence.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Integrity/observability high warning if CC mode changes or counter suppression align with high power/allocation without approved explanation.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Track mode, counter availability, attestation report, and timing of mode changes.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Security mode is a privacy/observability tradeoff; do not penalize legitimate CC-On except by lowering no-run confidence.
rows.observable: Attestation, trusted computing, and device/telemetry provenance
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Some modes disable performance counters; devtools may expose counters but weaken protection
rows.source_basis: Uploaded matrix/notes; NVIDIA H100 confidential computing/attestation docs

rows.0__no_training_likely: Collector binary/config hash valid and stable; supports trust in absence/presence evidence.
rows.1__training_possible: Valid but changed under approved maintenance; no direct semantics.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: Unexpected collector/config change or unsigned batch during audit window.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: N/A as direct training evidence.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Integrity high warning if collector hash/signature becomes invalid or changes during candidate high-power/high-allocation windows.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Encode measurement hash, config version, signature validity, and overlap with candidate windows.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Use as a trust multiplier and missingness flag; not training evidence itself.
rows.observable: Attestation, trusted computing, and device/telemetry provenance
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Unexpected collector binary/config change during candidate window is suspicious
rows.source_basis: Uploaded matrix/notes; NVIDIA H100 confidential computing/attestation docs

rows.0__no_training_likely: >0.95 coverage for scheduler, GPU, fabric, power, storage, and integrity, with all primary signals absent, supports no-run.
rows.1__training_possible: 0.80-0.95 partial coverage: training may be possible but absence is not strong proof.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: <0.80 coverage or missing a critical primary layer during relevant windows: elevated uncertainty.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: N/A as direct training evidence; low coverage caps both positive and negative confidence.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Integrity high warning if coverage collapses selectively during high allocation/power or near capacity changes.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Compute coverage vector by layer plus overall minimum/critical-layer coverage.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Coverage is mandatory for negative certification. Do not impute missing telemetry as zero.
rows.observable: Monitoring-pipeline integrity, coverage, and time synchronization
rows.original_caveats: Apply separately to GPU, fabric, power, storage, scheduler.
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: <0.8 weak; 0.8-0.95 partial; >0.95 strong; full coverage needed for no-run claims

rows.0__no_training_likely: <0.01 gap fraction, no missed critical scrapes, and signed continuity.
rows.1__training_possible: 0.01-0.05 gaps: minor uncertainty.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 0.05-0.20 gaps or gaps in one primary layer during candidate windows.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: >0.20 gaps during candidate windows: strong integrity concern, not direct training proof.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Highest integrity warning if gaps are targeted to high-power/high-allocation/fabric-burst periods.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Use gap fraction, gap timing, layer affected, and overlap with power/allocation.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Differentiate maintenance from unexplained gaps; missingness should be a feature, not an imputed value.
rows.observable: Monitoring-pipeline integrity, coverage, and time synchronization
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Gaps during high-allocation/high-power windows reduce trust and may add anomaly score

rows.0__no_training_likely: <100 ms drift for high-resolution correlation, or <1 s where only coarse evidence is needed.
rows.1__training_possible: 100 ms-1 s: acceptable for coarse correlation; possible uncertainty at step level.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 1-10 s drift: undermines GPU/fabric/power alignment.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: >10 s drift, non-monotonic timestamps, or inconsistent clocks during candidate windows.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Integrity high warning if clock skew appears manipulated around candidate events or prevents cross-layer reconstruction.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Record max drift, time source, monotonicity violations, and layer-specific offsets.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: This affects evidentiary confidence, not training probability by itself.
rows.observable: Monitoring-pipeline integrity, coverage, and time synchronization
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Large drift undermines correlation across scheduler, GPU, fabric, power, and storage

rows.0__no_training_likely: 0 resets/config changes, or authorized changes outside candidate windows.
rows.1__training_possible: Isolated authorized change with retained before/after state.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: Repeated resets/config changes or any change during candidate window.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: Resets immediately before/after high-power/high-allocation windows.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Integrity high warning if resets/config changes suppress or erase primary counters during candidate windows.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Count resets, changed fields, affected layer, authorization, and overlap with candidate windows.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Some counters wrap naturally; distinguish wrap from reset and maintenance from unexplained change.
rows.observable: Monitoring-pipeline integrity, coverage, and time synchronization
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Resets/config changes during candidate windows reduce confidence; repeated pattern suspicious

rows.0__no_training_likely: No events, or authorized maintenance unrelated to candidate windows.
rows.1__training_possible: Scheduled maintenance with complete ticketing; possible explanation for telemetry anomalies.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: Physical access aligned with inventory changes or telemetry gaps.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: Unauthorized or unexplained access during candidate window.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Tamper high warning if unauthorized access aligns with hardware changes, telemetry gaps, and high power/activity.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Align access events with rack IDs, inventory deltas, attestation, power, and monitoring gaps.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Personnel/security records are not training evidence; use only for integrity/tamper hypotheses.
rows.observable: Physical security, maintenance, and change-management records
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Events aligned with inventory changes or telemetry gaps are integrity-relevant; not training evidence

rows.0__no_training_likely: No changes, or approved changes outside candidate windows with valid attestation afterward.
rows.1__training_possible: Approved maintenance changes; possible explanation for telemetry differences.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: Unapproved/unscheduled changes or changes near candidate windows.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: Unapproved firmware/BMC changes plus attestation/telemetry anomalies.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Tamper high warning if changes coincide with missing counters, hardware swaps, or high-power candidate windows.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Track approval status, measurement hash delta, affected devices, and timing.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Not a training signal. It modifies trust in telemetry and inventory.
rows.observable: Physical security, maintenance, and change-management records
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Unapproved changes near candidate windows indicate tamper risk; approved updates explain telemetry differences

rows.0__no_training_likely: Observed/expected ~=0.9-1.1 on claimed-idle GPUs; no hidden contention in sampled moment.
rows.1__training_possible: 0.8-0.9 or mild unexplained degradation; possible contention.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 0.5-0.8 during claimed idle: elevated hidden-use or power-cap suspicion.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: 0.2-0.5 repeatedly during claimed idle: likely hidden load or severe contention.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: <0.2 or probe cannot obtain expected compute on many supposedly idle GPUs, especially with high power or missing telemetry.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Normalize to hardware, power cap, temperature, and maintenance state; store probe schedule entropy.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Probes reveal availability/contention, not training semantics. Randomize and limit disruption.
rows.observable: Active challenge probes and weak-trust telemetry tests
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Low ratio in an allegedly idle window reveals hidden contention; high ratio supports idle availability but not no-run over all time
rows.suggested_aggregation_window: randomized spot checks; repeat across day/week

rows.0__no_training_likely: <1.2x expected latency on claimed-idle devices.
rows.1__training_possible: 1.2-2x: possible benign contention or thermal/power effect.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: 2-5x: elevated hidden workload/contestion suspicion.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: >5x repeated across many devices while declared idle.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Severe time-correlated latency inflation across many idle-claimed GPUs with high power/missing telemetry.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Use expected-vs-observed latency ratio and align with power, temperature, and declared idle windows.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Latency probes can be gamed if predictable; use as auxiliary weak-trust evidence.
rows.observable: Active challenge probes and weak-trust telemetry tests
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: High unexpected latency suggests contention, power cap, or hidden workload

rows.0__no_training_likely: Expected free HBM is available during claimed idle window.
rows.1__training_possible: Small unexpected occupancy; possible cache or benign co-tenancy.
rows.2__elevated_training_probability: Large unexpected resident memory while idle is claimed.
rows.3__training_likely_happening: Most HBM unavailable repeatedly across many idle-claimed GPUs.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Large-scale low free HBM across idle-claimed GPUs plus high power or missing process telemetry.
rows.aggregation_feature_engineering: Compare observed free HBM/residency latency to expected idle memory profile.
rows.dependencies_caps_interpretation_limits: Can conflict with tenant privacy; low free memory indicates hidden resident workload, not necessarily training.
rows.observable: Active challenge probes and weak-trust telemetry tests
rows.original_matrix_interpretation: Low available memory during idle claim suggests hidden resident workload

rows.0__no_training_likely: External estimate below policy capacity threshold, or site not capable after uncertainty interval.

rows.3__training_likely_happening: N/A as direct training evidence.
rows.4__highest_warning_definite: Inspection/discovery warning if unreported capacity is far above declared inventory and other site signals conflict.
